# Command-line interface

The following help is rendered from the same Clap command graph used by the `hsum` binary. Global options are repeated where Clap makes them available.

Generated from hSUM `0.1.0-alpha.4`.

See [configuration](config.md) for selection and managed-path precedence.

## `hsum`

```text
Local evidence for agents.

Usage: hsum [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init         Create one local filesystem-backed index and project
  trust        Authorize a canonical repository root for direct and MCP use
  ingest       Refresh configured sources into one atomic generation
  source       Configure and manage sources in the selected managed index and project
  project      Create, inspect, select, or retarget projects in one managed index
  index        Manage complete indexes by explicit logical name
  search       Search exact identifiers, conservative quotes, and active lexical text
  get          Resolve immutable bytes from an hsum://v1 citation
  status       Show index state and actionable problems
  doctor       Diagnose, narrowly repair, or export a body-free report for the selected index
  backup       Create or inventory verified, self-contained SQLite backups
  prune        Plan or apply citation-aware history pruning
  forget       Plan or apply durable citation-namespace forgetting
  restore      Apply the exact guarded restore plan emitted by forget
  migrate      Plan or apply a released N-1 schema migration
  config       Inspect or migrate user configuration and trust-registry schemas
  context      Show effective index, project, root, binding, and configuration origins
  help         Show offline guidance for a stable hSUM error subcode
  client       Generate or diagnose agent-client configuration
  integration  Install, activate, inspect, repair, or remove an agent integration
  model        Install, import, inspect, verify, or remove pinned local model artifacts
  completions  Generate shell completion content on stdout
  man          Generate the hsum manual page on stdout
  mcp          Start a project-bound, read-only MCP stdio server

Options:
  -v, --verbose...
          Increase diagnostic detail; repeat for more detail

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress progress while preserving errors and requested results

      --no-progress
          Disable progress while preserving warnings and lifecycle summaries

      --no-color
          Disable colored output

      --config <PATH>
          Use an explicit configuration file

      --data-dir <PATH>
          Override the managed data directory

      --cache-dir <PATH>
          Override the managed cache directory

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `hsum init`

```text
Create one local filesystem-backed index and project

Usage: hsum init [OPTIONS] [PATH]

Arguments:
  [PATH]
          Filesystem root; defaults to the enclosing Git root or current directory

Options:
      --index <NAME>
          Collision-safe logical index name

      --project <NAME>
          Collision-safe logical project name

      --rebuild
          Replace the trusted index for this root and re-ingest from scratch

      --no-ingest
          Create configuration and trust state without running the first ingest

      --dry-run
          Inspect selection and corpus estimates without writing

      --write-pointer
          Write the optional repository pointer

      --force-pointer
          Replace a conflicting repository pointer

      --allow-broad-root
          Confirm selection of a normally refused broad filesystem root

      --allow-large-source
          Confirm a source above the default file-count or byte limits

      --index-quota-bytes <BYTES>
          Maximum managed index bytes, including the required recovery reserve

      --embedding-model <MANIFEST_ID>
          Immutable embedding model manifest to pin without downloading it

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum ingest`

```text
Refresh configured sources into one atomic generation

Usage: hsum ingest [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dry-run
          Discover, validate, and estimate changes without committing them

      --lock-timeout-ms <MILLISECONDS>
          Maximum wait for the single-writer advisory lock

          [default: 5000]

      --allow-empty-snapshot
          Confirm replacing a previously nonempty source with an empty snapshot

      --allow-mass-delete
          Confirm an authoritative deletion above the mass-delete budget

      --source <ID_OR_NAME>
          Limit ingest to one source UUID or name; repeat to target several sources

      --strict
          Abort the complete index-wide ingest if any targeted source fails

      --reembed
          Rebuild complete vector membership from the selected index's pinned model

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum search`

```text
Search exact identifiers, conservative quotes, and active lexical text

Usage: hsum search [OPTIONS] <QUERY>

Arguments:
  <QUERY>
          Query text

Options:
      --mode <MODE>
          Retrieval mode; auto adds vectors only when compatible local evidence exists

          Possible values:
          - auto:     Exact identifiers and quotes plus lexical BM25
          - lexical:  Exact identifiers and quotes plus lexical BM25
          - hybrid:   Exact, lexical, and compatible local-vector retrieval
          - semantic: Compatible local-vector retrieval only

          [default: auto]

      --limit <LIMIT>
          Maximum number of returned passages

          [default: 10]

      --cursor <VALUE>
          Continue a stable, scope-bound result page

      --timeout-ms <MILLISECONDS>
          End bounded retrieval work after this deadline

          [default: 3000]

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

      --explain
          Include detailed retriever scoring and stop information

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## `hsum forget apply`

```text
Create recovery artifacts and atomically publish a compacted tombstone index

Usage: hsum forget apply [OPTIONS] --recovery-backup <OUTPUT> --restore-plan <OUTPUT> --confirm <PLAN_HASH> <--purge-managed-backups|--keep-managed-backups> <PLAN>

  <PLAN>

      --recovery-backup <OUTPUT>

          Maximum wait for the single-writer advisory lock

          [default: 5000]
```

## `hsum integration uninstall`

```text
Remove hSUM's client registration without deleting indexes

Usage: hsum integration uninstall --confirm <CLIENT>

Arguments:
  <CLIENT>
          Agent client whose hSUM registration should be removed

          [possible values: codex]

Options:
      --confirm
          Confirm removal of the client registration

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model`

```text
Install, import, inspect, verify, or remove pinned local model artifacts

Usage: hsum model <COMMAND>

Commands:
  install  Explicitly download one embedded-manifest model over HTTPS
  import   Import a verified air-gapped model directory or its receipt file
  list     List embedded model profiles and local installation state
  verify   Recompute every checksum for one installed model
  remove   Remove one installed model, refusing discoverable index pins by default
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model install`

```text
Explicitly download one embedded-manifest model over HTTPS

Usage: hsum model install [OPTIONS] <KIND> <ID>

Arguments:
  <KIND>
          Artifact class; Beta.1 supports local text embeddings only

          [possible values: embedding]

  <ID>
          Exact model ID from `hsum model list`

Options:
      --ca-bundle <PATH>
          Additional PEM certificate authority for a private HTTPS root

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model import`

```text
Import a verified air-gapped model directory or its receipt file

Usage: hsum model import [OPTIONS] <ARTIFACT_OR_DIRECTORY>

Arguments:
  <ARTIFACT_OR_DIRECTORY>
          Directory containing `hsum-model.json`, or that receipt file itself

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model list`

```text
List embedded model profiles and local installation state

Usage: hsum model list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model verify`

```text
Recompute every checksum for one installed model

Usage: hsum model verify [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>
          Exact model ID from `hsum model list`

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum model remove`

```text
Remove one installed model, refusing discoverable index pins by default

Usage: hsum model remove [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>
          Exact model ID from `hsum model list`

Options:
      --force
          Remove even when discoverable indexes pin this model

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON document

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum completions`

```text
Generate shell completion content on stdout

Usage: hsum completions <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>
          Shell completion format

          [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum man`

```text
Generate the hsum manual page on stdout

Usage: hsum man

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `hsum mcp`

```text
Start a project-bound, read-only MCP stdio server

Usage: hsum mcp [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --binding <UUID>
          Random user-side binding UUID generated by hsum trust or init

      --project <NAME>
          Project selected only inside an already trusted direct-CLI context

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
